title: AD HOC COMMITTEE FOR BOYLE HEIGHTS FIRE RECOVERY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a proposed interim control ordinance (ICO) on large cold storage warehousing…
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S10; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE FOR BOYLE HEIGHTS FIRE RECOVERY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a proposed interim control ordinance (ICO) on large cold storage warehousing and distribution uses in industrial areas of the Boyle Heights Community Plan area.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. NOTE AND FILE the Department of City Planning (DCP) report dated November 4, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. APPROVE the proposed Boyle Heights Community Plan Area Interim Control Ordinance (ICO), set forth as Exhibit A, including the Findings set forth in Exhibit B of the DCP report dated November 4, 2026, attached to the Council file.
3. INSTRUCT the City Attorney to prepare and present a draft Boyle Heights ICO including the environmental clearance.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the DCP. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Planning and Land Use Management Committee report to be submitted in Council. If a public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit https://lms.lacity.gov/home for background documents.)
